ctx.x: Oh, it was the Red Hot Peppers.
And was it during that period that you recorded with him?

items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Everybody was talking about him. In those days we called him Fats Armstrong... I just read Max Jones' book about Louis Armstrong a couple of weeks ago.

ctx.x: That was a lot of money then, wasn't it?

Oh, yeah, $1.10. It took you all day -- it took you all month to get $1.10. My mother used to give us a dollar to go to the store and come back with a bag of groceries this high for $1.10, $1.25, you know. Well, anyhow, I -- well, we, I'd say -- we were there, because Louis Armstrong was getting real famous. Everybody was talking about him. In those days we called him Fats Armstrong. Fats Armstrong. You know, Coleman Hawkins, and we'd heard the records. So anyway, I went to this dance and I heard Fletcher…
Was this when Louis was with the band?
